_about: What AnyCompany collected before this module: the defaults plus one org trail. Each key is one telemetry source the simulator writes only if it is true here.
name: first-draft
_cloudtrail_management: The org trail. Bedrock runtime calls (InvokeModel, Converse...) are management events, so they are here.
_cloudtrail_data_events: Off by default: no bedrock-mantle CreateInference, no AgentCore Runtime/Gateway data events, no S3 object-level events on the knowledge base bucket.
_invocation_logs: Bedrock model invocation logging is disabled by default.
_guardduty_ai_protection: GuardDuty is on (foundational plan) but the AI Protection plan was never enabled.
_app_log_identity: The web app logs path, status and latency. No end-user ID, no session ID, no request ID.
